known-entry.description: A forbidden import by importer, written target as check prints it and first-match rule.

language.description: May grow within archgraph/v1 as languages are added.

name.description: May grow within archgraph/v1 as collectors are added.

type_marking.description: Unavailable when dependency-cruiser could not distinguish implicit type-only usage; uncertain imports remain runtime.

main_packages.description: Go: the directories of package main packages (. for the root), sorted. Their files are commands, never public API. Absent otherwise.

bound_files.description: Native Go: every file, since tree-sitter cannot tell which files could leave their package and still compile. None of them is proposed for a move. Absent otherwise.

bound.description: Go: pairs of scanned files of one package that cannot be split across packages and still compile, sorted by from, then to. Their files are never proposed for a move. Absent otherwise.

names.description: The unexported names from uses that to declares, sorted: a field or method as Type.name, named by the type it is selected on (the outer type for a promoted one), anything else bare. Absent when none.

together.description: true when one file holds a method of a type the other declares, or both declare one name for different platforms. Absent otherwise.

go_modules.description: Go: the directories holding a go.mod (. for the root), sorted. No move is proposed from one Go module into another. Absent otherwise.

scan_root.description: Optional Git-relative scanned directory; . is the repository root. Used to bind workspace metadata to the scan.

package_modules.description: Go or Java scanned without --depth: every package directory is a module and depth is unused. Absent otherwise.

known.description: The known list beside the rules file (layout.known.yaml).

package_entries.description: TypeScript: files a package.json in the scanned tree publishes (exports, main, module, types), mapped from build output back to their sources. Public entries like barrels. Absent in older documents.

outgoing_to.description: outgoing_edges split by target module id, counted the same way (barrel-attributed file pairs); the values sum to outgoing_edges. Optional: absent in documents written before it was added.

globals.description: Host globals each file uses without declaring them, at their first use. Native JavaScript/TypeScript scans only; absent when not collected.

global.description: A host global a global: rule names; package then holds the global's name.

stale_known.description: Entries of the known list that no forbidden import matches. Absent when empty.

kind.description: runtime: load-time dependency; lazy: deferred dependency; type: erased or TYPE_CHECKING dependency; reexport: structural facade wiring. Legacy static/dynamic/type-reexport spellings remain accepted on input.

known.description: A forbidden import the known list beside the rules has. Absent unless true.

cochanged.description: With --cochange, pairs with one file on a claim rule's `from` side and the other on its `to` side in this slice, `from` side first, and no import either way. Absent when empty.

moves.description: Every slice a move rule touches, absent without moves. A slice whose files is empty has moved.

import_lines.description: Go: new (importer, imported folder) pairs across folders after this slice's moves. Other languages: import records, or edges when the collector keeps none, whose importer or target moves.

names.description: Go: the unexported names to export, from bound pairs whose two files land in different folders after this slice's moves, sorted by name; [] when none. null when unknown: native Go and other languages.

together.description: Go: bound pairs that move together or not at all (a method and its type, platform variants) whose files land in different folders after this slice's moves. Absent when empty.

new_cycles.description: Go only: imports in package cycles that applying every pending move together would create, with a file in one of this slice's source or destination folders. Absent when empty.

moved.description: Captured slices with no file left to move, of those with a file matching a move's from or already below its to. Absent without moves.

notes.description: Notes on the whole target, such as a move rule matching no file. Absent when empty.

slice-change.description: A claim's slice whose verdict changed, with the claim's reason and source and the slice's broken imports; an import's `line` is absent when the collector records none.

cycle.description: Strongly connected runtime dependencies by default; --all-kinds includes every kind. Deferred components are reported separately in type_only_cycles.

grouping.description: Module cycles only: true when no file cycle among the members' files (over the same import kinds) holds files of two or more members, so the cycle comes only from files sharing a module.

registrar_moves.description: Module cycles only, absent when empty: registrars (files wiring many modules, imported by at least one file) whose imports alone form the other side of 3 or more two-way pairs, each with a simulated move that adds no new cycle; with lists the other modules of those pairs. A file nobody imports is listed only when the cycle is grouping and the file is in its break set (entrypoint); an index file is never listed.

to.description: The simulated destination: a new folder named after the file (DriverFactory.ts into driver-factory/), in the file's folder when that is a module of its own at the scan's depth, else beside the module's folder; or the folder of the file's one importer. The move adds no new cycle.

pairs_removed.description: Two-way pairs over all module cycles before the move minus after.

cycle_before.description: Modules in this cycle before the move.

cycle_after.description: Modules in the cycle holding module after the move, 0 when it is in none.

entrypoint.description: Present and true when nothing imports file: an entry point whose deploy and config references follow the move.

two_way.description: Module cycles only: every pair of members that import each other, as the direction to cut: the lighter one (the names' order on a tie), unless it holds only wiring (registry) or a public entry's re-export (entry) and the other direction does not; an even pair names no lighter side. Sorted ordinary pairs first, then even, registry and entry pairs, each by imports, then from, then to. edges lists at most 20 of its file imports; imports counts them all.

even.description: Present and true when both directions have at most 2 imports, within a factor of 2: a mutual dependency with no lighter side to cut. from and to are then in the names' order, and imports counts from -> to.

registry.description: Present and true when the direction holds only imports of composition roots (a file nobody imports that imports 3 or more modules) and registrars (a file with 5 or more imports into the module), and the other direction holds no ordinary imports either: wiring, not a cut to offer.

resolved_by_move.description: Present and true when the other direction is only a registrar this cycle's registrar_moves moves: the move resolves the pair, which is not a cut to offer.

entry.description: Present and true when both directions hold a re-export by a public entry (a barrel or a package.json entry): public API, not a cut to offer.

rules.description: The parsed layout.yaml. archgraph rejects unknown keys when it loads layout.yaml; readers of a document ignore them.

to.description: Internal file glob, pkg:<package glob>, category:<declared category>, or global:<host global glob>. Package and global selectors match known external identities only.

source.description: Repository-relative ADR path supplying this rule.

to.description: Internal file glob, pkg:<package glob>, category:<declared category>, or global:<host global glob>. Package and global selectors match known external identities only.

source.description: Repository-relative ADR path supplying this rule.

moves.description: Where files go in the target, first match wins; used for move cost and progress only, never for verdicts.

to.description: A folder ending in /, without globs, that may use from's capture. A file goes to to plus its path below the literal leading folders of from.

default.description: The verdict for an import no other step decides. Absent means unplanned.

pkg-category.description: Named sets of package-identity globs for category:<name> rule targets. Members match collector package identities, without guessed aliases.

external_exposure.description: Advisory threshold on raw recorded external import occurrences; strict greater-than comparison. This does not change rule verdicts.

known.description: Of forbidden, those the known list beside the rules has. Absent when zero.

changes.description: A summary after a move, compared with the scan's summary: modules whose metrics did not change are left out, a module the move empties is null.

kind.description: Open: consumers ignore kinds they do not know. Known kinds type their evidence below.

own_module_edges.description: Edges in either direction between the file and the rest of its own module.

imports_from_target.description: Files of the target module that import the file.

evidence-internals-reach.description: Imports that bypass public entries, with every bypassing import counted: one finding per module without rules (subject: the module id), per bound public module with rules (subject: its pattern, such as src/domains/cart/**; module: the module of its first import's target).

importers.description: Distinct modules those imports come from.

importing_files.description: Distinct files those imports come from.

barrel_share.description: Without rules: the share of the cross-module imports into module that go through one of its barrels, at least 0.5 for the finding to be reported. Absent with rules.

edges.description: The bypassing imports, at most 20; imports counts them all.

imports.description: Runtime file imports (static and reexport, not through barrels) from a file of from to a file of to, at least 2.

new_unplanned.description: Imports unplanned in new whose pair is missing or has another verdict in old. Optional: added in v1 after the first release.

stale_known.description: Entries of the new scan's known list that no forbidden import matches. Absent when empty.

target.description: Claim progress between the scans, absent when neither has a target. Slices broken in new that were not broken in old are listed with their imports as newly broken, and slices broken in old that are not broken in new, also when no longer bound or gone, as newly fixed.

conforming.description: [old, new] captured slices that hold in every claim bound to them.

moved.description: [old, new] slices with no file left to move; present when both scans have moves.

newly_fixed.description: Slices broken in the old scan and not broken in the new one. A slice the new scan no longer binds, or whose files are gone, counts as fixed.

newly_vacuous.description: Claims vacuous in the new scan that the old scan states and that are not vacuous there, with the claim's notes on rule sides matching no file. Absent when empty.

newly_cochanged.description: Co-changed pairs a slice lists in the new scan and not in the old one, from-side file first; computed only when both scans read --cochange. Absent when empty.

moves.description: Every move in order, present only when more than one was applied; `move` is the first.

external-exposure.description: Per-module exposure from collector import occurrences, including unresolved imports in denominators. Absent when import accounting is unavailable; zero denominators yield null percentages. Advisory only.

kind.description: Open: consumers ignore kinds they do not know. Known kinds type their evidence below.
